label: D2 of a1 -> rare S2 after a previous unrewarded rare trial, very late in the episode (trials ~93-99)
explanation: Very sparse feature, only at D2. Every activation is a step where the agent chose a1 and landed in S2 by a rare transition, the previous trial was unrewarded (reward input 0), and almost always the previous trial was also rare (usually a1 -> S2 rare as well), or unknown at the window start. Value at these steps is in the lowest bin (<5.2), and policy logit favours a1 (2.8-8). Activations occur only in trials 90-99 of the episode, and the rate goes up toward the episode end. ep_trial >= 93 gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.27, and >= 97 gives F1 0.70. The top examples (0.9-1.0 of max) are rare a1 -> S2 trials coming after an earlier rare a1 -> S2 trial, mostly in S1-good blocks. It never fires at D1/GO, after a2, on S1, or after a rewarded trial. Matching steps that are inactive are common, so some further factor (probably accumulated hidden-state drift late in the episode) controls whether it fires. Every variable used is observed at D2.
